reason:
Fixed UART_Receive_IT to properly handle interrupt-driven reception in emulation. The original function had hardware register access (huart->Instance->DR) and hardware-specific interrupt operations. The new implementation:
1. Replaces hardware register reads with HAL_BE_In for data reception
2. Removes all hardware-specific interrupt enable/disable operations
3. Preserves the state machine logic for receive completion
4. Maintains callback functionality for receive completion events
5. Handles both standard and IDLE event reception modes
6. Properly updates buffer pointers and transfer counts
This ensures the function works correctly in emulation without hardware dependencies.
